final_wiki.answer-Q-6053-A59:
Q-6053: How many days are there from 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-12 (count the end date but not the start date)?
Answer: 364

Calculation: From 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-12.
- From 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-13 would be exactly 365 days (2021 is not a leap year, so the period from Dec 13 2020 to Dec 13 2021 includes Feb 2021 which has 28 days, total 365).
- We want up to 2021-12-12, which is 1 day less than 2021-12-13.
- So 365 - 1 = 364 days.

Answer: 364
